name: AWA Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Won by Jestin Mounts at a pay-per-view the record does not otherwise hold, then defended successfully here against Rae Lyyn through a chaos of outside interference.

name: AWA Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Held by Marshall Gates going into a non-title main event he wrestled to a no-finish before turning on his own stable; the record does not attest when he won it or what became of the title after.

name: AWA World Championship
epitaph: Held by Alan Fiscus, billed by the promotion's own commentary and the owner alike as its World Champion; the record does not attest when he won it.
